diagram_previews.alt: Coordinate axes with the equilateral triangle O(0,0), P(-1,sqrt3), Q(1,sqrt3) drawn dashed and its centre G. Three parabolas pass through O, P and Q: the blue y = sqrt3 x^2 with vertex O opening upward, and its red and green images under rotations of 120 and 240 degrees about G, with vertices at Q and P.

difficulty_rationale: An unstated approach requiring some exploration and a few connected steps.
